name: Affan Saeed
details: I grew up in Lahore, Pakistan, and was introduced to 286 machines in 1988 by my father. This was the same period when I started learning coding using GWBASIC and Lotus. I have successfully completed MCS, and MIBF from KU, and have proven experience in local/International niches that involves my freelancing endeavors as well. In a successful career spanning more than 10 years, I have mastered the art of making Cloud Applications with C# using Amazon/Google APIs and automation using Selenium.
